findings.description: Touch-down captures phase, call identity and action generation; release clears the latch then rejects any changed identity, phase or generation. Accessibility activation uses the current visible operation.
Pointer equality treats two nil call IDs as the same current SIP session; UI phase transitions increment the generation, rejecting a stale nil-ID gesture across distinct calls.

checks: Reviewed production gesture and all phase generation changes against frozen r6.
Reviewed actual host result: 42 selector checks, zero failures; full host lane and historical app build pass.
limitations: Host selector invocation does not prove UIKit event delivery. Independent iPad1 UIKit runner is in progress; its final results need separate review.
No production device deployment or physical actuator qualification.
